data.name: 10 Years After
data.detailed_description:
Please Note :

DISCLAMER2 : I CAN NOT MAKE THIS TEXT ANY BIGGER! THIS IS A VERY EARLY ALPHA GAME PLEASE DO NOT BUY THIS GAME UNLESS YOU WISH TO SUPPORT IT GOOD AND BAD FEEDBACK IS ALWAYS WELCOME BUT PLEASE REMEMBER THIS IS A GAME GOING THROUGH MANY MAJOR CHANGES IF YOU LIKE A GAME THAT HAS WEEKLY UPDATES AND BIG CHANGES TO THE GAME PLAY THEN GO FOR IT! , IF YOU DON'T THEN PLEASE FEEL FREE TO PASS ON IT FOR NOW

*DISCLAIMER* - Do not opt into this Early access game, if your are not happy to play a game that may have the tendency to crash, be buggy and slightly broken mechanics. We are working hard on fixing and updating features so please bare with us :)

Thank you for supporting us in joining in the early access alpha of 10 Years After ...There will be bugs and features missing so prepare to cry
and to laugh (floating pig anyone?) Please use our social links to report any problems and we hope you enjoy playing the game
At the moment there is only a basic save system this will be upgraded in a future release ...please bear with us on this......Also Crafting will start to play a bigger role in the game as new updates role out.


More quests and main story still to be added.





“10 Years After” Is a survival based horror (Open World) Single Player Adventure ..........After the government rolled out a injection to the general public to stem the violence and quell the human emotion's things were going well ….....Peace on earth was achieved people who were injected were added to the “Calm Register” no murders no rapes no crime ...it was a utopian society....That is until things went wrong and the injection bites back!




-Single player

(With unique Fully Voiced character driven storyline)

-Fully Voiced Audio Diaries to help you find out what happened to the city's inhabitants

-Full Soundtrack for the game

-Survival

-Hunger/Thirst System

-Player Crafting

-Hunting

-Infected

-Guns

-Melee Items

-Dynamic Weather

-Day & Night Cycle

-Apocalyptic Radio Broadcasts

-Puzzles

-Hostile NPC'S (If you come across one of these its best to take them out quietly so as not to alert others)

reviews.review:
OMG!!! I hope the developer decides to roll back to the original version of the game from 2015, because the game which I just re-installed and played was a complete different game.  

It started off well enough, I saw a camp, a much better start than the original game which saw you awakening in a hospital.  I made my way outside and began talking to a few NPC's..  Ok gooe enough, nothing to see here..

Jim Bob, or Billy Bob, or whatever the heck his name was instructed me to take up arms as infected were coming to play.

I went into the gun shack and!!!!  Controls didn't work..  Alarm bell goes off...  gun shoots ring out..  Still nothing, I can see my gun sitting there, taunting me,  yet it won't pick up.

After a 20 seconds about 20 infected decided to invade the Gun Shack... WTF happened to the Zombie models from the 2015 game, these ones were stretch out and odd looking.  Fake, unrealistic.. The only one that looked even slightly decent resembled Slenderman I guess.   I can't imagine which part of the development team decided altering the game in such a way was a good idea..

This has to be one of the single worst games I've ever played, the SS's on the storepage were taken from the 2015 version of the game, which are no longer valid,  the newest version of this game is a complete and and utter flaming turd.  This game which had so much potential at one time is totallly.....  "In the words of Gordan Ramsey, the developers are out of control"  They took the few positives and removed them, stamped on them, set them on fire, and continued to add gasoline just to ensure no resembelence to a good game existed.

I'd suggest you never buy this game, in fact if you feel like buying this game, poke out your eyes with an ice pick, or better yet, gather up all your worldly possessions and burn them.  In fact just burn yourself. you'll have more fun waiting for your skin to char and crisp then you'd ever have playing this piece of crap.

Ugg I played the updated game for a few minutes and needed a shower, I now know how an inmate feels after being passed around for a few cigerettes..  

[h1] PLEASE DON'T BUY THIS GAME, TRUST ME, BURN IT, KILL THE ABOMINATION[/H1]
